description: Send a draft, or a rejected form that was fixed, for review: it becomes in_review, we check it (usually within minutes) and then file it with the carriers (usually 4 to 5 business days). The first form for a business carries the business attestation, signed by someone authorized to act for it, with the name they give in this conversation. Answers with problems while anything the carriers require is missing. No fee.

attestation.description: Signed by someone authorized to act for the business, once per business: that they are authorized, that the details match the business's IRS records, and that the business will text only people who agreed to it and will follow the Messaging Policy. Kept as signed, with the exact wording, who sent it (the API key), the IP address, the user agent and the date of our legal documents.

accepted.description: Must be true: the person signing agrees to the statement.

signer_name.description: The full name of the person signing.
